The most common effect of all the psychedelics I've taken is the fractal patterns that you'll see when you close your eyes, and given a high enough dose, when your eyes are open.

Physical effects of phenylethylamines like LSD and NBOMEs is similar to Adderall and other amphetamines. You will not be able to sleep for 10-14 hours after taking these drugs. You will not feel hungry. You might even feel a little nauseous, so it's best to dose up on an empty stomach.

Mushrooms are similar, but only last for 4-6 hours. The effects are similar to the phenylethylamines, but different. Psilocybin is a tryptamine, so it's a different molecular structure.

I don't know what else to say. Ask me anything about psychedelics if there's something you want to know.

The trip went off the rails after a couple hours and couldn't recover. I had never expereinced anxiety before that moment and it was the most isolated, emotionless, inhuman feeling (or lack thereof) that I could ever have comprehended. I rode out the trip and felt pretty scatterbrained but relieved that it was over. I was wrong.

I developed an anxiety disorder that would haunt me for 5 years. The first 3 months were daily panic attacks that I kept in check by self medicating with alcohol and cutting classes on days I felt on edge. The first couple years or so I probably had weekly panic attacks. I never sought out treatment, though looking back I probably should have. As far as I can tell is that the anxiety attacks were rooted in nothing other than my newfound knowledge that consciousness is completely fluid and that there is nothing stopping your brain from losing control of itself. I should mention that I never had deranged thoughts, only emptiness and disinterest in the world around me.

Here I am 9 years later and I no longer get anxiety attacks. However, I have become more emotionally reserved (I tend to not experience happiness and sadness as pronounced as most people), probably a learned response to keep myself in the driver's seat. I consider myself well adjusted and do not think there will be future setbacks from my bouts with anxiety.
